2610.11704.title: Intervention anchors and scientific verification in synthetic vascular predictive representations
2610.11704.paper_summary: Complete orthogonal predictive coordinates do not by themselves bind a latent direction to a named intervention. We present a mathematical and synthetic audit motivated by vascular device-vessel suitcordance. Capacity-matched least-squares predictors were exactly equivalent under complete fixed output transforms, whereas an anchor-only observer recovered interpretations only within the span of known perturbation signatures. Six three-dimensional configurations across 64 seeds gave a maximum paired prediction discrepancy of 6.7e-15 but a median untransported edit error of 1.513. Coordinate transport removed that error. Noisy and weak anchors constrained calibration stability, and changing the representation basis required recalibration or verified transport. Across 256 additional fits in dimensions 3-24, prediction equivalence persisted within 4.0e-15. We then evaluated nine deliberate runnable fault classes across 64 seeds. All 576 faulty executions completed, but each violated at least one reconstruction, prediction, delivered-edit or scope contract; all 320 valid control records passed. Repeating a faulty implementation gave exact self-agreement despite error against the separately computed simulator expectation. For one omitted-direction defect, probe coverage followed its analytic law, and rank-aware abstention protected unsupported interpretations. Scalar-noise experiments exposed both missed weak faults and excessive rejection under narrow relative tolerances. These controls provide an executable separation of prediction, semantic support and scientific acceptance. They are synthetic numerical audits, not clinical validation, neural JEPA-Anything replication, agent learning or patient treatment-effect estimation.
2610.11704.paper_summary_zh: 完整的正交預測坐標本身並不將潛在方向與命名的干預綁定。我們提出了一個數學和合成的審計，這是由血管裝置與血管的適配性所驅動。容量匹配的最小二乘預測器在完全固定輸出變換下是完全等價的，而僅依賴錨點的觀察者僅在已知擾動特徵的範圍內恢復解釋。六個三維配置在64個種子中給出了最大配對預測差異為6.7e-15，但中位數未傳輸編輯錯誤為1.513。坐標傳輸消除了該錯誤。嘈雜和弱錨點限制了校準穩定性，並且改變表示基礎需要重新校準或驗證傳輸。在3-24維的256個額外擬合中，預測等價性在4.0e-15內持續存在。我們然後評估了九個故意可執行的故障類別，涵蓋64個種子。所有576個故障執行均已完成，但每個都違反了至少一個重建、預測、交付編輯或範圍合同；所有320個有效控制記錄均通過。重複故障實現給出了精確的自我一致性，即使與單獨計算的模擬器期望存在錯誤。對於一個省略方向的缺陷，探測覆蓋遵循其分析法則，而考慮排名的棄權保護了不支持的解釋。標量噪聲實驗暴露了錯過的弱故障和在狹窄相對容忍度下的過度拒絕。這些控制提供了預測、語義支持和科學接受之間的可執行分離。它們是合成的數值審計，而不是臨床驗證、神經JEPA-任何複製、代理學習或患者治療效果估計。
